entry.title: Paul Loudon (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Paul Loudon was described as a "human battering ram" (pictured)?

entry.title: Battle of the Bosporus (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the Battle of the Bosporus, one of the largest naval battles in the Middle Ages, was fought during the night in a storm in a narrow strait?

entry.title: Terry Davis (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Terry Davis created TempleOS, a Bible-themed operating system that had more than 120,000 lines of code?

entry.title: two EF2 tornadoes (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that two EF2 tornadoes merged near downtown Tallahassee in 2024?

entry.title: Peng Chi-ming (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that environment minister Peng Chi-ming drafted Taiwan's first weather insurance policy?

entry.title: Los Angeles Rising (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Los Angeles Rising was put together by two musicians who had been forced to evacuate their homes due to the January 2025 wildfires in Los Angeles?

entry.title: Hit N Fun (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the lead cast of Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In reunited to star in the unrelated film Hit N Fun?

entry.title: The Hungry Five (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that The Hungry Five were credited with maintaining the unique ownership structure of the Green Bay Packers?

entry.title: loneliest elephant in the world (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the zookeeper of the "loneliest elephant in the world" credited her with saving his marriage?
